notes.title: Check out gameplay of the first Year 3 character, Sagat!
notes.content:
The first Year 3 character, Sagat, joins the fight on August 5, 2025!
[previewyoutube=sBNCSeG391Y;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sBNCSeG391Y[/previewyoutube]

Sagat made his debut as the final boss in the original Street Fighter and later became a playable character in Street Fighter II: Hyper Fighting. In this installment, he brings not only his signature long-range attacks and versatile projectiles, but also several new moves that allow him to adapt to any battle situation.

Witness the power of the Muay Thai Emperor in action!

On the same day, Sagat’s Outfit 2, which recreates his classic look from Street Fighter II, will also be available.
- Outfit 2 can be unlocked in World Tour mode by meeting certain conditions.

The Year 3 Character and Ultimate Pass are now on sale!
Sagat can be unlocked individually using Fighter Coins, or will be automatically added for those who own the Year 3 Character Pass or the Year 3 Ultimate Pass.
- Additional content will be released sequentially.
- For product details and release schedule, please check the official website.

Get Street Fighter 6:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364780/Street_Fighter_6/

Visit the official website:
https://www.streetfighter.com/6/
